note: Candidate datasets investigated for independent external validation of the Phase 7I experimental model. Downloads were NOT performed in 7K; the three locally-held files below were already acquired (Phase 7G) and are re-analyzed. Web-search candidates are documented with their recorded limitations.

candidates.name: Columbia University Disease-Symptom Knowledge Database
candidates.source: Columbia DBMI; extracted from 25,074 NYP 2004 discharge summaries via MedLEE NLP; UMLS-coded (AMIA 2008, PMC2656103)
candidates.license: UNKNOWN - no explicit license statement; manual review required (contact friedman@dbmi.columbia.edu)
candidates.observation_type: aggregated clinical associations (real discharge-note origin), NOT case/patient-level rows
candidates.status: ANALYZED ONLY - CONDITIONAL CANDIDATE (license pending; insufficient feature/label coverage)

candidates.name: Kaushil268 - Disease Prediction using Machine Learning (Kaggle)
candidates.source: Kaggle dataset kaushil268; fetched Phase 7G via public GitHub raw mirror; Apache-2.0
candidates.observation_type: canonical symptom->disease KB rows (same family as SymbiPredict; 304 unique signatures)
candidates.status: REJECTED for 7K - SAME canonical family as SymbiPredict -> NOT independent (mirror/leakage risk). Approved only in Phase 7G as a cross-check mirror.

candidates.name: SymbiPredict / SDPD (Mendeley)
candidates.observations: 4,961 rows (41 classes x 121) -> 304 unique signatures used in Phase 7I
candidates.observation_type: canonical community-curated associations, NOT patient records
candidates.status: REJECTED for 7K - THIS IS THE TRAINING SOURCE (Phase 7I); cannot be used as external validation (in-sample).

candidates.name: Disease and Symptoms dataset (~800 diseases, 600 symptoms; Kaggle choongqianzheng + variants)
candidates.source: Kaggle; Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning family
candidates.status: REJECTED for 7K - SAME canonical disease-symptom KB family as SymbiPredict -> not independent; undocumented provenance.

candidates.name: Disease-Symptom Dataset (773 diseases / 377 symptoms; Kaggle dhivyeshrk) + Mendeley 'Disease and symptoms dataset 2023' (246k rows)
candidates.observation_type: ARTIFICIALLY GENERATED symptom->disease rows (self-described), preserving 'Symptom Severity and Disease Occurrence Possibility'
candidates.status: REJECTED for 7K - synthetic/generated rows describing canonical KB associations; not independent real observations; speculative coverage.

candidates.name: DDXPlus (1.3M synthetic patients, 49 pathologies, 110 symptoms)
candidates.source: Tchango et al., NeurIPS 2022 / figshare 20043374; synthea+proprietary KB
candidates.license: figshare terms; research use documented in paper
candidates.observations: ~1,300,000 synthetic patients; 49 pathologies; 110 binary/categorical symptoms + antecedents
candidates.observation_type: SYNTHETIC patients generated from a medical KB (Synthea); not real clinical observations
candidates.status: REJECTED for 7K - synthetic cohort, not independent real observations; feature representation (categorical, negative framing) incompatible with lean binary prerequisite; large acquisition not justified.

candidates.name: Brazil SINAN dengue/chikungunya/SARI notifications (PMC12819417, 2025)
candidates.source: Brazilian epidemiological surveillance (SINAN); Scientific Data description
candidates.observations: case-level records (dengue, chikungunya) with binary symptom columns (fever, headache, rash, nausea, vomiting, arthralgia, myalgia, retro-orbital pain...)
candidates.status: REJECTED for 7K - real but single-disease; class coverage ~2.4% is too small to support a 41-class generalization claim.

candidates.name: OUCRU Ho Chi Minh City dengue cohort (12,000+ patients, 1999-2021)
candidates.source: Oxford Univ Clinical Research Unit; PMC9992802
candidates.observations: >12,000 real patients, single disease (Dengue), WHO warning-sign categories
candidates.status: REJECTED for 7K - single-disease; access-restricted; class coverage too small.

candidates.name: MIMIC-III clinical database
candidates.label_overlap_41: labels not aligned to symptom-based 41 classes
candidates.feature_coverage: lacks a ready symptom-presence matrix (per DDXPlus paper: 'often lack symptom-related data')
candidates.status: REJECTED for 7K - no symptom presence matrix; credentialed access; not usable as-is.

candidates.name: symptoms2Disease (Kaggle niyarrbarman, 24 diseases / 1200 natural-language descriptions)
candidates.observations: 1,200 rows; 24 diseases; free-text symptom sentences (same disease family)
candidates.observation_type: paraphrased natural-language symptom descriptions; derived from the same known disease-symptom KB family
candidates.status: REJECTED for 7K - paraphrases/derivatives of same canonical family -> not independent; free-text tokens require unsupervised alignment -> mapping inadequate.

conclusion: No independently-sourced, patient/case-level, adequately-covered dataset is obtainable. Best genuine independent candidate (Columbia KB, real clinical origin) fails license clarity and feature/label coverage; all other real datasets are single-disease or unaligned; the large Kaggle/Mendeley sets are the same canonical family or synthetic. No external evaluation was performed.
